 FAA ground stop order impacting travel plans for Iowa, Purdue game 
 The FAA’s ground stop order on Friday has impacted travel plans for the Iowa and Purdue game. By KCRG Staff Published : Nov. 13, 2026 at 6:13 PM CST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google IOWA CITY, Iowa (KCRG) - The FAA’s ground stop order on Friday has impacted travel plans for the Iowa and Purdue game.
 The Indianapolis Star is reporting the Purdue football team will now travel by bus instead of plane.
 Kickoff between Iowa and Purdue is Saturday night at 6:30 p.m. at Kinnick Stadium.
